events.title: US-Japan Coordinated Yen Intervention (First Since 1998)
events.source: Reuters, CNBC, Japan Times, Al Jazeera
events.description: US Treasury and Bank of Japan conducted coordinated yen-buying intervention. First joint US-Japan operation since 1998. Bessent reportedly wrote 'Buy Japanese Yen $5-10 bil' on notepad. Both sides signal readiness to intervene again.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis - IRGC Harassing Shipping
events.description: 2026 Iran war active. IRGC Navy harassing vessels in Strait of Hormuz. Brent crude spiked 10-13%. Iran threatens to close strait. US-Iran negotiations ongoing via Oman. UKMTO reported failed attack on vessel Aug 2.

events.title: Ebola Bundibugyo PHEIC - Intensifying in DRC
events.description: WHO declared Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16, 2026. 1,801 confirmed deaths in DRC, 2 in Uganda. Outbreak intensifying with sustained transmission. Vaccine candidates entering clinical trials.

events.title: Gold at $4,304 - Safe Haven Panic
events.description: Gold surges above $4,285, spot at $4,304.3. USD index dipped below 100. Safe haven demand driven by Iran war, Fed rate expectations, dollar weakness.

events.title: South Korea-US-Japan Trilateral FX Intervention
events.description: Unprecedented joint FX intervention by South Korea, US, and Japan. Korean won surged 8.8% - fastest since financial crisis. Won hits 9-month high. Carry trade risks persist.

events.title: Israel-Gaza Escalation Despite Peace Plan
events.description: Israel escalates Gaza attacks, defying Trump peace plan. 1,250 killed since October 2025 ceasefire. Warplanes striking without prior warnings. Hamas agreed to disarm but Israel continues attacks.

events.title: Brazil-Argentina Diplomatic Crisis
events.description: Brazil downgrades diplomatic ties with Argentina after Milei insults Lula. Brazil withdrew ambassador. Crisis threatens economic relationship - most important in Argentina foreign trade.

events.title: China Deflation - 10 Quarters of Falling Prices
events.description: China property crisis ongoing since 2021. S&P expects primary home prices to fall 1.5-2.5% in 2026. PBOC signals stronger counter-cyclical support, moderately loose monetary policy. Household wealth destruction compared to US 2008.

events.title: Sudan Conflict - 500K Trapped Under RSF Siege
events.description: 500,000 trapped under RSF siege in El-Obeid. Drone strike on court in North Darfur kills dozens. International aid only 40% funded. No diplomatic breakthrough in sight. Mali offensives also ongoing.

events.title: OPEC+ Completes Rollback of Production Cuts
events.description: OPEC+ agreed to raise production by 188,000 bpd in September - 6th consecutive monthly increase. Completes phased rollback of voluntary supply cuts from 2023. Members cannot fill existing quotas.

events.title: Russia Banking Stress - Sberbank Warns of Rising Credit Risks
events.description: Sberbank reports deterioration in loan quality Q2. Impaired loans increasing. Corporate borrowers face mounting pressure from slowing economy. Bankruptcies rose 13.7% YoY in Q1.

non_events.note: Fed held rates at 3.5-3.75% in July. New chair Kevin Warsh emphasizing inflation. Markets pricing in hike. No emergency action.
ECB kept rates unchanged at July 23 meeting. Forward curve pricing 40bps of hikes by end-2026. No emergency.
BOE held at 3.75% for 5th meeting. Signaled could raise if Iran war escalates. Gilts falling toward 4.9%. No emergency.
